label: Cobalt

sourceNotes: The PCPS technical documentation (Table 3) gives the specification and unit above. The SDMX codelist names the indicator "Cobalt, US dollars per pound" and "Cobalt, U.S. cathodes, spot"; the stored values are on the per-tonne basis the documentation states.
missingValueHandling: Every month from the first published value to the cutoff has a value. The ingest fails on a gap rather than interpolating; calculations that need an absent month return no value.
limitations: Monthly averages of weekly or daily values; a month's figure is not a price on any single day.

Cobalt hydroxide and cobalt sulphate, used in battery supply chains, trade on separate terms.
